name: Unresolved Chess Game
description: If you wish to earn the mages' approval, you must face up to the riddle at hand.

tabs.name: Memories: Wager With the Mages I
tabs.description:
Legend has it that on the long river of nothingness, only after untold epochs of longing did the children-who-should-not-be earn themselves a name.
For of late, mindful of the children's fate, the mages have assented to the opening of a World Gate.
Revisit this challenge in your memories once more, and you may gain something new from the encounter...
